errors.evidence: The legend and plot show that the MEMIT line has pentagon-shaped markers, not circular ones. The Base line has circular markers.
The Base method starts at a value clearly below 30%, at approximately 28%.
The ROME method's final data point is significantly higher than 56%, at approximately 58%.
The line for the MEND method does not plateau; it continues to rise in the last segment, although the slope decreases. Describing it as a plateau is an inaccurate interpretation of the trend.
The ROME method starts at approximately 44%, not 43%.
